name: El
source:
A young mermaid who is the Queen Mermaid’s daughter. Having never left her mother’s side, it seems as though she has never before appeared before a human that her mother hates so much. Due to her frequent swims in rough seas, her small body is surprisingly strong. Although her direct sexual experience is almost nothing, she has received lots of instructions from her mother.

Though she is interested in humans, she also wants to catch a human and toy with them like other mermaids. But since human contact was forbidden to her by her mother, she hasn’t been able to act on those desires. In addition, the starfish on her waist is an accessory bag. It contains pretty coral, shiny marbles, shells and other treasures. Also assorted candies to snack on.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
